title: Lunchline hero
description: On wide screens a full-window video under a dark tint, a huge light headline top-left and a light lead paragraph bottom-right from 58% across; on phones the headline and lead sit on cream above a 1.32 video band. An optional cream splash with the wordmark fades away on load, then the headline's letters rise into place one after another (each from further down) and the lead fades in.
notes: window-sized on wide screens (100svh); content-sized on phones, with 92px top room for the fixed lunchline-header
the media slot is a placeholder until you pass a video or image; it is tinted with foreground/55 on wide screens and the type there uses the background colour, so a dark theme inverts it
CSS only: the load animations are keyframes, off with reduced motion
